why: a tile holding a photo is read as a pill again and absorbs its photo
a button painting its own picture is a pill again and absorbs its badge
a link painting its own picture loses its link (or is a pill again)
a button painting its own picture is a whole-card link
a plain link with one label is a whole-card link, never a pill
the picture tile drops its link
an empty role=img element painting a url() is left unresolved
a role=img element that paints no url() becomes a media block
a background url() is not a painted picture
